title: Frontend Growth Roadmap
summary: Personalized guidance to close gaps for your target direction. Focus on production skills and job-relevant topics — not a full course.
skillStageSummary: You have React and TypeScript fundamentals with some Vue exposure. Next priorities: React Query for server state, Testing Library for component tests, and Next.js App Router for production delivery.

items.title: React Query for server state
items.reason: Repeatedly flagged as missing in job fit reports and required for modern React apps
items.gapDescription: You fetch data with useEffect but lack patterns for cache, pagination, and mutations
items.suggestedGoal: Confidently explain server vs client state and implement list + detail queries with loading/error states
items.careerImpact: High — common requirement on React/Next.js JDs
items.suggestedNextAction: Copy the practice prompt and build a Job List page this week
items.practiceIdea: Build a Job List page with loading, error, pagination, refetch, and a save/unsave mutation

learningPrompts.beginner: Teach me React Query in Traditional Chinese. Assume I know React useState and useEffect, but I do not understand server state. Explain the difference between React Query and Redux/Zustand with practical API fetching examples.
learningPrompts.practice: Design a React Query practice task for a Job List API. Include loading, error, pagination, refetch, and mutation requirements. Do not give me the solution immediately.
learningPrompts.interview: Help me prepare an interview answer for why React Query is useful and when it is better than fetching data directly in useEffect.
learningPrompts.debugging: Walk me through debugging a React Query issue where data refetches too often after a mutation. Explain staleTime, cacheTime, and invalidation mentally.
learningPrompts.project: How would I add React Query to a CareerOS-style job board? Outline folder structure, query keys, and which pages need queries vs mutations.

practiceTasks: Implement useQuery for GET /jobs with pagination
Add useMutation for toggling saved status with optimistic updates
interviewQuestions: When would you choose React Query over Redux for server data?
How do you handle authentication errors globally?

items.title: Testing Library fundamentals
items.reason: Missing from profile vs multiple JD requirements
items.gapDescription: Limited evidence of component/integration tests in projects
items.suggestedGoal: Write tests for user-visible behavior on 2–3 components
items.suggestedNextAction: Write tests for resume analysis UI components
items.practiceIdea: Write tests for resume analysis components: loading state, error message, and successful skill list render

learningPrompts.beginner: Explain React Testing Library philosophy in Traditional Chinese. Why test behavior not implementation? Show a simple button click test.
learningPrompts.practice: Give me a practice exercise: test a JobCard component with title, company, and Apply button — include accessibility queries. No solution yet.
learningPrompts.interview: Help me answer: How do you decide what to test in a frontend feature?
learningPrompts.debugging: My test fails with 'Unable to find role'. Teach me a debugging checklist for RTL queries.
learningPrompts.project: Outline a minimal test setup for a Next.js App Router project using Vitest and Testing Library.

practiceTasks: Test async data loading with findByRole
Mock fetch in one integration-style test
interviewQuestions: Unit vs integration tests on the frontend?
How do you test custom hooks?

items.title: Next.js App Router
items.reason: Nice-to-have on JDs; strengthens full-stack-leaning frontend profile
items.gapDescription: Experience may be Pages Router only or limited dynamic routes
items.suggestedGoal: Ship one feature using App Router, layouts, and dynamic [id] routes
items.suggestedNextAction: Build job detail pages with dynamic routes
items.practiceIdea: Build job detail pages using App Router and dynamic routes with loading.tsx

learningPrompts.beginner: Explain Next.js App Router vs Pages Router for someone who knows React SPA routing.
learningPrompts.practice: Design a practice: job list + job detail with dynamic [id], loading UI, and not-found handling. No code yet.
learningPrompts.interview: Prepare an answer: When do you use Server Components vs Client Components?
learningPrompts.debugging: Help me understand hydration errors — common causes and how to fix them in App Router.
learningPrompts.project: Map CareerOS pages to App Router structure: which should be server vs client components?

practiceTasks: Add a shared layout for dashboard sections
interviewQuestions: SSR vs SSG vs ISR tradeoffs?
How do you fetch data in Server Components?

items.title: Playwright E2E basics

items.gapDescription: No E2E tests demonstrated in portfolio

learningPrompts.beginner: What is Playwright and when should frontend engineers use it vs Testing Library?
learningPrompts.practice: Create a Playwright exercise for testing job search filter + results count. Requirements only.
learningPrompts.interview: How do you structure Playwright tests in CI for a monorepo?
learningPrompts.debugging: My Playwright test is flaky on CI — common causes and fixes?
learningPrompts.project: List 3 E2E scenarios worth automating in CareerOS MVP.

practiceTasks: Install Playwright in a Next.js app
Run tests in headed and headless mode
